about: Evidence for the Simulation Theater V2 NFL team colour map (app/src/lib/simulation-theater/nfl-team-colors.mjs). Data only: no component imports it, it never ships in a bundle, and the colour-literal scanner (lib/uiux/color-scan.mjs, .ts/.tsx/.mjs/.css) does not read .json. Hex values only, no logo or brand asset stored. dev-route-colors.test.mjs recomputes every flag and every derived value from this file.

rules.validated: A source AGREES with a team when it lists colours within CIE76 ΔE ≤ validationDeltaE of BOTH the map's primary and its secondary. official = some official source agrees; agree = sources from two independent families agree (nflHeader, nflLogo and wiki are one family, NFL.com's); validated = official || agree.
rules.roles: primary = the team's primary brand colour (score-bug block, end zone, possession tag) — painted in every matchup, home or away; secondary = its main contrasting brand colour (block trim where it reaches 4.5:1, and the field colour where the primary cannot be told from the turf); accent = the team's DECLARED FIELD COLOUR, painted in every matchup (drive ribbon, timeline fills, scoring flash, winner outline, break-card rule). Every role value is listed VERBATIM by at least one official source (officialSources below). fieldColour (per team) records which role the field colour is and why.
rules.contrast: Text on a team block (ink, and the trim used for end-zone lettering) ≥ 4.5:1 on that block. On the field and the timeline, contrast comes from TREATMENT, not a substituted hue: the official value is painted as is, and every team mark carries a light keyline (--st-keyline = --lava-text 85% into --bg, #D2D3D2), the boundary WCAG 1.4.11 measures (≥ 3:1 on both turf stripes, the timeline panel and the page). The possession tag is a miniature score-bug block (fill, ink ≥ 4.5:1, keyline). Outlines drawn on an end zone (winner, reduced-motion scoring flash) sit on a halo in that end zone's ink (≥ 4.5:1 on its fill). No colour is lightened or replaced for contrast.
rules.collisions: NO COLOUR IS EVER SWAPPED. A pairing CLASHES when the two primaries collide (CIE76 ΔE < 20: score bug, end zone, possession tag) or the two field colours clash (fieldClash: CIE76 ΔE < 20 or CIEDE2000 ΔE00 < 10; CIE76 calls dark pairs such as BUF royal / IND blue, ΔE00 5.9, distinct). Then the AWAY side is `patterned` and is told apart by non-colour cues (WCAG 1.4.1): diagonal stripes of the keyline (with a dark hairline) over its own colour on its timeline segments, drive ribbon, end line and score-bug bar; its abbreviation on its timeline segments wherever they are ≥ 34 px wide (and, as for every team, on the possession tag, the score bug and the end zone); a pennant-shaped possession tag pointing the way it attacks; square ribbon ends. The home side stays plain, so exactly one side carries the cues.
rules.identity: One identity, never swapped (founder, 2026-10-18: keep Buffalo's royal blue #00338D in every matchup, including away games, and apply the same principle to every team). The field colour is the primary except (1) where a founder role decision names another official colour (NO and PIT gold: their black is ΔE00 11.2 from the turf; TB's official red #C2242B) or (2) where the primary cannot be told from the field surfaces even keylined: CIEDE2000 ΔE00 < 20 against either turf stripe or the timeline panel (fieldDistinct) — then the secondary. Exception 2 applies to GB, NYJ, PHI, CHI, CLE, HOU and LV (re-examined in iteration 6, every one under 20). JAX now paints teal and TEN Titans blue, their primaries.

nflHeader.name: NFL.com team page, profile-header colours (overlay, stripe)

nflLogo.name: NFL.com club logo SVG, fill colours (league-hosted club mark; white omitted)

caveats: No team's or the NFL's brand-guide PDF was publicly reachable; therams.com/brand/ is password protected and was not entered.
Many Wikipedia values are byte-identical to NFL.com's, so Wikipedia is grouped in NFL.com's family and never counts as independent of it.
NFL.com renders every black as #000000, including the Panthers', whose own site uses #101820; a club's own value outranks NFL.com's.
The league-hosted DEN logo is the legacy 'D' mark; DEN's current colours come from NFL.com's header.
matchupsNote: Every matchup in the 2026 shadow receipts (the theater's possible fixtures): the palette theaterPalette() paints, recomputed by the test. clash = why the away side carries the cues (blocks / field / both), absent when the pairing does not clash.
